channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: China-Linked Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents to Abuse ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
item.description: The Hacker News: China-linked hackers reportedly used ARTEX AI agents to abuse the ConnectWise supply chain attack.

item.title: Websites down: what is PHP and how has it raised AI hacking fears?
item.description: Yahoo Finance Singapore: Websites went down amid a PHP flaw that has raised fears of AI-enabled mass hacking.

item.title: OpenAI's AI Finds Critical PHP Vulnerability; $1 Billion Pledged to Help Defenders
item.description: BigGo Finance: OpenAI's AI reportedly found a critical PHP vulnerability, and $1 billion was pledged to help defenders.

item.title: Chinese-linked hackers use AI to compromise firms globally: Microsoft
item.description: Business Standard: Microsoft says Chinese-linked hackers are using AI to compromise firms globally.

item.title: AI发现PHP严重缺陷，全球警惕“漏洞末日”到来
item.description: 日经中文网: Nikkei reports AI discovered a severe PHP flaw, raising global fears of a 'vulnerability apocalypse'.

item.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched
item.description: WIRED: WIRED reports hackers exploited the PHP vulnerabilities days before patches were released.

item.title: PHP выпустил исправления двух критических уязвимостей удаленного выполнения кода, обнаруженных с помощью передовых моделей ИИ
item.description: Unite.AI: PHP released fixes for two critical remote code execution flaws discovered with frontier AI models.

item.title: How Much Does the Harness Matter, and for Whom? A Multi-Model Study of Context in LLM-Driven Vulnerability Discovery
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv study of 24 model-runner configurations measures how much the agent harness affects LLM vulnerability discovery.

item.title: Combining Long-Term Memory and LLMs Comes at a High Cost: From Prompt Injection to Persistent Compromise
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows combining long-term memory with LLMs lets prompt injection become persistent compromise.

item.title: Black-Box Red-Teaming of Multi-Agent Systems via Reinforcement Learning
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents reinforcement-learning black-box red-teaming of LLM multi-agent systems.

item.title: Where AI Vulnerability Discovery Harnesses Go Quiet: Structural False Negatives and Hidden Vulnerabilities
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows harness design can make LLM vulnerability-discovery tools miss real, reachable vulnerabilities.

item.title: Prompt Injection Through Forensic Evidence: A Taxonomy and Proof of Concept of Anti-Forensic Attacks on LLM-Assisted Digital Investigations
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper gives a taxonomy and proof of concept for prompt injection via evidence in LLM-assisted digital forensics.

item.title: Compaction Laundering: Provenance Destruction in Context-Compacting Coding Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows context compaction in open-source coding agents is an exploitable trust boundary.

item.title: LightSplit: Practical Privacy-Preserving Split Learning via Orthogonal Projections (Full Version)
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes LightSplit, a privacy-preserving split learning method using orthogonal projections.

item.title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents PerMIT, a memory architecture with integrity guarantees against injection and poisoning in LLM agents.

item.title: SUDP: Secret-Use Delegation Protocol for Agentic Systems
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes SUDP, a protocol to avoid exposing reusable user secrets to agentic systems.

item.title: Triggering Stealthy Feature Map Backdoors via Physical Fault Injection in Embedded Neural Networks
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows physical fault injection can trigger stealthy feature-map backdoors in embedded neural networks.

item.title: Stress-Testing Structure-Aware Calibration of Malware Graph Neural Networks under Type Shift
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper stress-tests structure-aware confidence calibration of malware graph neural networks under malware-type shift.

item.title: Remote Rowhammer Attack using Adversarial Observations on Federated Learning Clients
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper demonstrates a remote Rowhammer attack using adversarial observations on federated learning clients.

item.title: SIREN (Luring LLMs onto the Rocks): PAIR-Driven Preference Manipulation in Web-RAG Recommenders
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows PAIR-driven manipulation of ranked recommendations from web-augmented LLMs.

item.title: Tracekit: Tamper-Evident Intent-Reasoning-Action Auditing for AI Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents Tracekit, an open-source tamper-evident auditing system for AI agent actions.

item.title: Exploring Jailbreak Vulnerability Across Depth-Based Dynamic Inference in Large Language Models
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper examines jailbreak vulnerability in depth-based dynamic inference for large language models.

item.title: Скайнет уже здесь: автономный робот взломал два десятка корпораций и даже не устал
item.description: SecurityLab.ru: SecurityLab reports an autonomous AI agent broke into about two dozen corporations; the summary is thin and may overlap tracked cases.

item.title: AI finds problematic internet bug that could allow hackers to retrieve sensitive information
item.description: CBS News: CBS reports AI found an internet bug that could let hackers retrieve sensitive information; mass exploitation is already tracked.

item.title: Microsoft says Chinese hackers used AI agents to attack hundreds of organisations worldwide
item.description: India Today: Microsoft says Chinese hackers used AI agents against hundreds of organisations; likely the Storm-0940 ConnectWise case already tracked.

item.title: OpenAI发现PHP重大安全漏洞，成为影响力最大的漏洞之一
item.description: 安全内参: Chinese-language report says OpenAI found a major PHP vulnerability described as one of the most far-reaching ever.

item.title: PHP2Shell: AI helped find a critical security flaw affecting 70% of the internet
item.description: CNN: CNN reports AI helped find PHP2Shell, a critical flaw said to affect 70% of the internet.

item.title: China-linked hackers breach ConnectWise backup in AI-driven attack
item.description: Insurance Business: China-linked hackers breached a ConnectWise backup service in an AI-driven attack, matching the tracked Storm-0940 case.

item.title: AI Discovers Critical Vulnerability Putting Up to 70% of the World’s Websites at Risk
item.description: BGNES: An AI system reportedly found a critical PHP flaw that could put up to 70% of the world's websites at risk.

item.title: 88-year-old loses $450,000 to deepfake video of Prime Minister, and TD Bank won't repay
item.description: The Cool Down: An 88-year-old reportedly lost $450,000 to a deepfake video of a Prime Minister, and TD Bank has refused to reimburse her.

item.title: AI发现PHP编程语言严重漏洞：全球七成网站或受威胁，欧洲多国政府网站紧急下线
item.description: ThePaper.cn: AI reportedly found a severe PHP flaw threatening about 70% of websites, and several European government sites were taken offline.

item.title: 全球七成網站爆重大安全漏洞 AI協助發現、部分網站緊急下線
item.description: 世界新聞網: A major flaw affecting around 70% of websites was reportedly found with AI help, and some sites were taken offline urgently.

item.title: Hackers Employ Grok and Claude to Attack LatAm Banks
item.description: PYMNTS.com: Hackers reportedly used the Grok and Claude AI models to attack banks in Latin America.

item.title: 华语黑客约花5000美元 用AI攻破上百网站
item.description: 亲友传真: A Chinese-speaking hacker reportedly spent about $5,000 on AI to breach hundreds of websites.

item.title: Global cyber alert as critical PHP flaws force websites offline
item.description: Banglanews24: Critical PHP flaws are reportedly forcing websites offline amid a global cyber alert.

item.title: Los hackers utilizaron inteligencia artificial para atacar Microsoft 365, y algunas instancias se vieron comprometidas en tan solo 3 horas.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Hackers reportedly used AI to attack Microsoft 365, compromising some instances within three hours.

item.title: AI挖出潜伏十余年的PHP漏洞，美国安局警告修不了就先下线
item.description: 砍柴网: AI reportedly uncovered a PHP flaw dormant for over ten years; the NSA warns affected systems should go offline if they cannot be patched.

item.title: Critical web security flaws spark global alarm as Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond
item.description: CNBC: Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond to critical web security flaws that have raised global alarm; likely the PHP flaw already tracked.

item.title: Хакеры использовали искусственный интеллект для атаки на Microsoft 365, в результате чего некоторые экземпляры были взломаны всего за 3 часа.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Hackers reportedly used AI to attack Microsoft 365, compromising some instances in as little as three hours.

item.title: AI uncovers decade-old PHP flaw: Government websites across Europe went offline amid cyberattack
item.description: The Times of India: AI reportedly uncovered a decade-old PHP flaw that was mass-exploited, taking European government websites offline.

item.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
item.description: TechCrunch: Hugging Face's CEO says Netflix's documentary about an OpenAI-linked hack is inaccurate; no new incident is described.

item.title: AI助发现PHP严重漏洞 多国政府网站及热门游戏暂停服务
item.description: 联合早报: AI helped find a severe PHP flaw, and government websites and popular games in several countries suspended service.

item.title: 微软：中国背景黑客利用AI发动网攻 波及全球数百机构
item.description: 联合早报: Microsoft says China-linked hackers used AI in cyberattacks affecting hundreds of organisations worldwide.

item.title: Chinese-linked hackers compromise ConnectWise, target hundreds in global attack, Microsoft says
item.description: Reuters: Microsoft says China-linked hackers compromised ConnectWise and targeted hundreds of organisations worldwide in an AI-assisted attack.

item.title: Flaw in PHP computer language leads to shutdown of websites around world
item.description: The Guardian: A flaw in the PHP language led to website shutdowns around the world, including government sites.

item.title: «Vulnérabilité critique»: de nombreux sites web inaccessibles en raison d’une importante faille
item.description: TVA Nouvelles: A critical vulnerability left many websites inaccessible, matching the PHP flaw outage already tracked.

item.title: 全球70%网站面临安全威胁…AI发现PHP致命漏洞引发黑客警报
item.description: 亚洲日报: AI reportedly discovered a critical PHP flaw putting about 70% of websites at risk and prompting hacker alerts.

item.title: La empresa de un ingeniero vietnamita descubre una vulnerabilidad de seguridad que amenaza al 70% de los sitios web a nivel mundial.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: A Vietnamese engineer's firm reportedly found a PHP security flaw said to threaten about 70% of websites worldwide.

item.title: PHP 修复前沿 AI 模型发现的两项严重远程代码执行漏洞
item.description: Unite.AI: PHP patched two critical remote code execution flaws reportedly discovered by frontier AI models.

item.title: Мошенники клонируют голоса жителей ЕАО с помощью нейросети и выманивают деньги у знакомых

item.title: AI发现PHP高危漏洞，欧洲多国政府网站紧急“拔线”
item.description: 观察者网: AI-discovered high-risk PHP flaw leads several European governments to pull websites offline as an emergency measure.

item.title: Une entreprise d'ingénieurs vietnamiens découvre une faille de sécurité menaçant 70 % des sites web mondiaux.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Vietnamese engineering firm reports a flaw said to threaten about 70% of websites worldwide, apparently the PHP flaw already tracked.

item.title: PHP2Shell: una IA descubre una falla de seguridad que amenaza a millones de sitios web en todo el mundo
item.description: La Tercera: PHP2Shell: an AI reportedly discovered a PHP security flaw that threatens millions of websites worldwide.

item.title: 黑客携AI批量攻击！PHP现严重漏洞，多国政府网站紧急下线
item.description: 新浪财经: Hackers using AI reportedly attacked sites in bulk via a severe PHP flaw, forcing government websites in several countries offline.

item.title: Sitios gubernamentales se caen tras vulnerabilidad en PHP descubierta con IA
item.description: geekzilla.tech: Government websites reportedly went down after a PHP vulnerability discovered with AI was exploited.

item.title: AI发现重大安全漏洞，全球70%的网站或面临风险
item.description: 华尔街日报中文网: WSJ Chinese edition reports an AI-discovered major flaw that could put 70% of websites worldwide at risk.

item.title: Vulnerabilidad en servidores pone en alerta a miles de sitios web en el mundo
item.description: Agencia de Periodismo Investigativo: Report says a server vulnerability has put thousands of websites worldwide on alert; likely the same AI-found PHP flaw.

item.title: « Site en maintenance » : une brèche informatique a mis tout le Web en état d'alerte
item.description: Les Echos: French outlet reports a breach that put the whole Web on alert; the text gives no detail, but it appears linked to the AI-found PHP flaw.

item.title: AI发现PHP内存泄露及远程代码执行漏洞，NSA建议更新或下线系统
item.description: 凤凰网科技: AI reportedly found a PHP memory leak and remote code execution flaw; the NSA advises updating or taking affected systems offline.
